3) Order form draft + signature (Aug 19–25) — finance to sign; order form references MSA effective date.
4) Pilot kickoff (target Sep 7) — prereqs: signed DPA, order form, operational checklist complete (ingress IP allowlist, test tenant provisioned).

Owners (from Redwood):
- Legal: marcus_lin (redlines & final MSA)
- Security: laura_bennett (SOC2 artifacts & KMS notes)
- Sales/Eng ops: karthik_iyer (MAP coordination, pilot runbook)

Acceptance gates for pilot (recommended):
- Stage 1: Technical validation (3 days) — API connectivity + low-volume inference test
- Stage 2: Performance sanity (2 days) — 95th percentile latency within agreed thresholds
- Stage 3: Data handling verification (2 days) — DPA compliance checks on logs & retention
I attached the MAP and an annotated timeline. If this looks good I’ll schedule a short working session (30m) with your procurement + legal to agree owners and dates.

Copying in three quick legal points after a first read of Orchid's DPA questionnaire:

1) We will propose a streamlined DPA counter-sign (2 business day internal turnaround) but need to align on subprocessor list — request Orchid provide current vendor list by Aug 9.
2) For MSA redlines: we will push for an order-form-first flow where the order form references the MSA and any appendix as the governing terms; if Orchid needs MSA executed first we can prioritize redlines week of Aug 9 but that may delay order form signature by ~1 week.
3) Liability/indemnity: suggest a cap tied to the pilot fee (not unlimited). I'll prepare redlines and a short memo explaining our position.

I attached the initial redline doc (redlines_msa.docx) — it flags a few clauses that typically cause back-and-forth. Proposed plan: 48–72h turn for each round of redlines, with a single exec escalation call if we hit an impasse.

Marcus Lin
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redlines_msa.docx (Word)
